hypotheses.S0_exact_head_recomposition: All-head state recomposition error remains at most 1e-3.
hypotheses.S1_rank2_true_payload_transfers: The rank-two discovery payload basis reaches held-out output fidelity at least 0.80 relative to the complete frozen three-head program in at least four material families.
hypotheses.S2_true_payload_beats_matched_arbitrary_: The true rank-two basis exceeds matched arbitrary-edit bases by at least 0.10 in mean held-out program-output fidelity.
hypotheses.S3_true_payload_beats_gaussian_subspaces: The true rank-two basis exceeds matched Gaussian subspaces by at least 0.10 in mean held-out program-output fidelity.
hypotheses.S4_rank1_often_suffices: A rank-one true payload basis reaches held-out program-output fidelity at least 0.80 in at least four material families.
hypotheses.S5_payload_is_more_output_compact_than_s: For at least three families, rank-two output fidelity exceeds residual-state energy fidelity by at least 0.20.
